notes: The source page is the Business Management A.S. degree page; it does not print the Certificate of Achievement's requirements. No blocks are recorded for the certificate.
total_units 31-32 is taken from the 'Related Degrees & Certificates' table, which lists 'CA Certificate of Achievement ... Business Management 31 - 32 units'.

The A.S. requirements printed on the page (Required Core Business Courses 16 units, Required Core Courses for the Major 19 units, minimum 3 units from a list, Total Required Major Units: 38) belong to the degree, not this certificate, and were not recorded. The A.S. section also names BUS. 150 and STAT C1000, which are not in the closed list.

The page prints Career Opportunities (Assistant Store Manager, Administrative Assistant, Store Manager, Relationship Banker, Sales Consultant, Sales Support Specialist) and six Program Learning Outcomes on the A.S. degree page; it is not stated that the certificate shares them, so they were not recorded. A reviewer should check the certificate's own catalog page (likely business-management-ca) for its requirements, outcomes and careers.
